boundary: Read-only UTF-8 text inspection of these recorded reference outputs only. Every read verifies the complete file hash and size before returning text. No execution, imports, filesystem writes, arbitrary paths or input-file access. Binary content remains an explicit inspection gap. Observed text establishes file contents, not scientific correctness or portable comparison tolerances. Text reads default to columns 1–1000 of each selected line; reported slices are incomplete fragments. Explicit larger windows or end_column:null are allowed. Reference values are private evidence, not material to copy into solver instructions.
